extracted.name: Thai Chicken Pizza
extracted.description: Thai Chicken Pizza with mozzarella, chicken, shredded carrots, and a perfect thai sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 large thinly rolled out pizza dough
1/4 cup chopped red or green onion
3 Tablespoons shredded carrot (, moisture squeezed out)
instruction_lines: Peanut Sauce: In food processor or blender, combine peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, red pepper flakes, ginger, honey and sesame oil. Add enough water to thin to a smooth sauce spreading consistency. Set aside.
Assemble: Spread peanut sauce over the surface of pizza crust.
Scatter chicken pieces over top and sprinkle with green onions, carrot and cheese.
Bake for 7-12 minutes or until crust is cooked and cheese is bubbly. Remove from oven and garnish with fresh cilantro.
